segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: An invasive species is a plant, animal, or other organism that is introduced into an ecosystem, usually by humans.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: An invasive species can cause harm to its new environment.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: An example is when humans introduced goats to the Galápagos Islands.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: The Galápagos are a chain of islands roughly 1,000 kilometers off the coast of Ecuador.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Throughout the 1800s, people, mostly whalers and explorers, stopped at the islands during long ocean voyages.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: At that time, long ocean voyages made it hard to keep fresh meat on ships, so sailors released goats on some islands as a living food supply they could hunt later when passing through.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: They most likely didn't know how much their actions were going to damage the islands.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Goats are very adaptable and can survive in harsh environments like the Galápagos.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: They definitely are not picky eaters.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: They consume everything from tough shrubs to grasses, so they didn't run out of food easily.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: With no natural predators, their population exploded.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: As time went on, the goats' eating habits caused native plants, like one species of cactus, to mostly disappear.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: And that was a huge problem for native animals like giant tortoises.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: These tortoises rely on plants like this cactus for food and shade.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Without them, many tortoise populations collapsed.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: So how can we address this problem?

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Well, in the early 2000s, conservation efforts began to reintroduce tortoises to islands where they had gone extinct.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Let's take a look at these efforts and determine how effective they've been.
